observation: The packaged calculateRegression computes slope from two screen points and assigns width max(10, screen line length * 0.1). It does not fit candle closes.
replacement: Least squares over selected candle closes by bar index, with bands at two population standard deviations of residuals.
evidence_type: static syntax observation plus direct source inspection; replacement verified separately by unit and browser tests
limitations: Static analysis did not execute the library.
Per-file semantic node limits resulted in partial graph coverage.
Only the selected source file was analyzed.
No proprietary TradingView bundle or native executable was analyzed; Ghidra was not used.
